title: Crispy Mozzarella Eggs on Avocado Toast
subtitle: with honey and chilli oil
description: Grated mozzarella fried on honey with a soft-boiled egg, piled onto avocado toast and finished with chilli oil.

steps.text: Make soft-boiled eggs: boil the eggs for 6-7 minutes. Transfer to iced water, peel and halve.
Heat a non-stick frying pan. Drizzle 4 small mounds of honey, then scatter the grated mozzarella in an even layer over the honey.
Place the egg halves on the cheese. Fry over medium heat until the cheese melts, turns golden and crisps up.
Mash the avocado, season with salt and pepper and spread on slices of toasted bread.
Place the crispy mozzarella eggs on top.
Drizzle with chilli oil and serve immediately.
